segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone skin is the most frequently named skin type, with reviewers reporting fewer breakouts and better oil control, including several who call it a holy-grail cleanser for oily, acne-prone skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report it controls oil in the T-zone effectively while the formula stays gentle on the rest of the face.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry skin found it more suited to dry or regular skin, and another with sensitive dry skin liked the scentless, gentle texture.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who patch-tested first because of unfamiliar ingredients, generally report no reaction.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with long-standing acne, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within one to two weeks; a smaller group, including one who had a severe rash reaction to the reformulated version, report new breakouts or bumps instead.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report it controls oil and shine, particularly in the T-zone, without leaving skin stripped.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleans deeply without drying out their skin, though a few describe it as drying, especially with daily use, and recommend using it every other day instead.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer's skin became swollen, sensitive, and leathery after switching to the reformulated cleanser, a severe reaction not echoed by other reviewers.

extraits.texte: To start off, it is, of course, not a fair replacement for the original product. This is not a reworked formula, but a completely different product. I am extremely disappointed to say that not only did it not meet my expectations, it has damaged my skin like no other product that I have ever used. Within the first week of using the new cleanser, my skin had broken out in a rash that is now healing. My skin is swollen, sensitive, and leathery. This cleanser is the only change in my otherwise very simple routine. I had never prior to this used a product that resulted in such an adverse reaction

This product has clean packaging and comes with a generous amount of product. The cleanser is a thicker consistency that doesn't take much to lather. It doesn't have much of a scent which u like! This product isn't for my skin personally because I have super sensitive combo skin. I broke out after the first use which is a typical experience for me so not the products fault. I think it's great for regular to dry skin and will continue to try ole Hendriksen products. Thank you for this complimentary item!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser would be much better on an oily skin person. I have combination skin and my t zone is oily and the cleanser did a great job taking the extra oil off my face.

extraits.titre: My new go-to face wash! I will buy this over & over!!! WOW
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have absolutely fallen in LOVE with this cleanser!!! I am switching over to this permanently now! I have extremely oily, acne prone skin. I am 33 years old and have struggled with acne my whole life. This cleanser cleared up a breakout for me in a week!!!! That's incredible & I am still pimple free while on my period, it's AMAZING! I've never had something feel & work this good on my face! I took photos of my journey using this cleanser and wow, I am impressed! The first picture was when I started, middle after one week of use, and the last photo is after 2 weeks of using this product! I LOVE it! It doesn't have a strong scent, it sort of reminds me of cucumber, just a light & clean scent. It's thicker than the cleanser I usually use and I love it, it feels like it's truly moisturizing my skin while also cleaning it! My skin feels so much softer and fresher after this and I haven't been suffering from dry skin on my face since I started using this! I very much highly recommend trying this if you have acne prone skin like me! It has been an absolute GAME CHANGER for me!!!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I actually really enjoy this cleanser as someone with sensitive and dry skin. I also have many pores on my face. There is no smell to this and the texture is nice.

extraits.titre: If you have oily and/or acne prone skin this is a LIFE SAVER
extraits.texte: I have cystic acne and normal face washes don't work very well on me, but this clean ingredient magic in a tube helped tone down any breakouts I had without over drying, so def safe to use day and night!!

The packaging is super nice. Its texture is milky and thin. It doesn't create lots of foam, but its cleansing ability is very well. My skin is sensitive combination and acne prone but I did not have new acne since using this. The scent is very light as cucumber scent. Highly recommend!
